description: This file implements a QR Code generator library in Python, including classes for QR code symbols and data segments, with methods for encoding text and binary data, generating SVG representations, and handling error correction and masking.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Represents an immutable QR code symbol with methods for encoding data, generating SVG, and managing error correction and masking.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a data segment to be encoded in a QR code, with methods for creating segments in various modes and calculating total bits.

classes.name: _ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Handles Reed-Solomon error correction code generation for QR code data blocks.

classes.name: _BitBuffer
classes.description: A helper class for appending bits and packing them into bytes.

methods.name: encode_text
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode text string into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encode_binary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encode_segments
methods.description: Encodes data segments into a QR code with custom parameters, automatically choosing version and error correction.

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Returns the QR code's version number.

methods.name: get_size
methods.description: Returns the size (width and height in modules) of the QR code.

methods.name: get_error_correction_level
methods.description: Returns the error correction level used.

methods.name: get_module
methods.description: Returns the color (black/white) of a specific module.

methods.name: to_svg_str
methods.description: Generates an SVG string representation of the QR code with specified border.
